title: You Don’t Need to Spin at 90 RPM—That’s a ’90s Myth
content:
High cadence made sense for WorldTour pros on EPO. For the rest of us, pedaling slower is often more efficient, and you can probably skip the cadence drills.

Read the full article at You Don’t Need to Spin at 90 RPM—That’s a ’90s Myth on Velo.
author: Josh Ross
